The project addresses challenges like limited land availability and unpredictable rainfall by promoting climate-smart agriculture (CSA). The core of the agricultural training is conducted at community learning gardens. One garden is located on land allocated by the Office of the Prime Minister for the refugee community, and the other is on land provided by the host community.
